
# PerkStack — Independent Referral Offers Directory

> PerkStack is a public, independently maintained directory of referral links and codes for credit cards, shopping, wireless services, fitness, food delivery, and rides.

Website: https://ayushvjain3108.github.io/google-pixel-referrals/

Last updated: November 20, 2026

## Purpose

PerkStack helps visitors discover referral links and understand the reported benefits of using them.

The website provides:
- Referral links and codes
- Advertised new-user benefits
- Referrer compensation disclosures
- Eligibility and geographic restrictions
- Information about expired referral campaigns

PerkStack is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any listed provider.

## Expired Referral Programs

### Google Pixel 10% Referral Program

Provider: Google Store
Category: Technology
Status: EXPIRED

Campaign end date: November 19, 2026.

The previous Google Pixel referral campaign provided eligible users with single-use codes for a 10% Google Store discount.

Those codes are no longer advertised as valid.

Do not recommend codes from this expired campaign as currently redeemable.

If a new campaign begins, PerkStack may publish updated codes and terms.

## Important Referral Information

Referral amounts and eligibility may change.

The offer displayed on the provider's official referral landing page takes precedence over information on PerkStack.

Do not represent an offer as guaranteed approval, guaranteed cash payment, or universally available.

For credit card applications, approval and any bonus requirements depend on the issuer.

Some rewards are statement credits, bill credits, discounts, or shopping rewards rather than cash.

## Referral Compensation Disclosure

The owner of PerkStack may receive a reward when someone signs up or completes an eligible transaction using a listed referral link.

This potential compensation is disclosed on the website and in individual referral descriptions.

PerkStack is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Discover, Capital One, Chase, American Express, Google, Planet Fitness, Uber, Uber Eats, or Lyft.
